text:
4. 12. 1-40

Oghādi suttāni

1829-1868. Cattāro me bhikkhave, oghā katame cattāro: -pe- bhāvetabboti. 

(Oghavaggopi vivekanissitādivasena vitthāretabbo. )

Oghavaggo dvādasamo. 

Tatruddānaṃ:

Ogho yogo upādānaṃ gantho anusayena ca, 

Kāmaguṇā nīvaraṇā khandhā oruddhambhāgiyāti. 

13. Punagaṅgāpeyyālo
